question: What happens to properties with duplicate keys when spreading two objects: `{ ...{ a: 1, b: 2 }, ...{ b: 99 } }`?
options: The second object's value overrides the first: { a: 1, b: 99 }
Both values are preserved as an array: { a: 1, b: [2, 99] }
The first object's value is kept: { a: 1, b: 2 }
explanation: In object spread operations, properties evaluated later in the sequence overwrite any preceding properties with the same name.
